findings_closed: Exact closed/interrupted/tools root whitelist; no automatic roots or nested overlap; live roots and whole Git worktrees rejected.

Sealed/tools roots require external expected hashes for every retained file. Complete maps must be derived from prior seals and approved receipts; a seal label or seal-file hash alone cannot reseal changed raw.
Only .py/.rs/.sh/.bzl may be exact Git source dependencies; local bytes are verified. JSON/NPZ/binary/XML/log raw remains included. Git publication itself remains separately host-verified.
Plan and archive output are canonical paths inside the approved workspace and outside every evidence root; input collisions and overwrite are rejected before write.
Tool/source identities checked during planning/measurement, each content stream and immediately after archive verification before finalization.
Hardlinks refer only to a preceding verified ordinary member with identical SHA256, byte count and archived mode; no symlink, traversal, forward link or chain.

Bounded independent verifier checks embedded manifest, exact tar/PAX framing, every content hash, hardlink identity, padding/footer, gzip CRC/EOF; rejects extra gzip/tar data and truncation without extraction.
Actual capacity/fsync probe, effective UID-sensitive free-space check, explicit compressed size cap and disk reserve; failure retains partial output rather than publishing success.
Archive finalization and receipt use no-overwrite links and directory fsync; fsynced complete receipt is the only publication commit marker.
Receipt distinguishes evidence/regular/hardlink/manifest/logical member counts and notes inode/mtime/ctime as concurrency checks, not scientific identity or original-time restoration.
remaining_preconditions: Root must approve exact final roots and full historical expected maps after all output owners declare closure.
Root must approve plan SHA and explicit output/disk budget before real measurement or packing.
Old V5/V6 and V7/V7b raw archives remain exact external prerequisites, not automatically copied.
review_kind: read-only source and saved small-fixture qualification review; no duplicate test run
